verdict.rationale: Parahelp's guardrails page shows topic-based handoff rules, e.g. "when a ticket is about an enterprise account, transfer it to the enterprise team with a summary note" (docs-7). Separately, any tool can be gated behind Slack human approval, so nothing runs until someone approves (docs-31, docs-6). That covers routing sensitive topics to humans and blocking risky actions, but the evidence doesn't show these topic rules are strictly enforced rather than natural-language instructions the agent could stray from. Missing for 10: proof that human-only topics are hard-enforced so the agent never replies on them, examples for categories like legal threats, cancellations or security, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
